Market sections follow the events; no war-driven price calls.

items.text: The S&P 500 fell 2.0% to 7,176, its sixth straight loss; the Nasdaq fell 2.25% and the Dow about 1,100 points, under 50,000. The wires tied the late slide to renewed rate-hike talk and to money rotating toward the Anthropic debut.
items.source: Yahoo Finance live blog; Motley Fool; 24/7 Wall St.

items.text: Anthropic began trading at 08:50 PT, opening about 34% above its $83 offer price and closing about 17% above it. Alphabet and CoreWeave fell as holders re-priced stakes and took profits.

AMD fell about 8% after a short seller disclosed a position; Nvidia slid again as investors weighed its chief executive's departure against a quarter that doubled revenue and profit. Chips turned red at 09:24 PT.
The Trump-Xi meetings ended with little change on chips, rare earths or tariffs.
Friday 20 Nov is the monthly options expiry: the S&P monthly settles at the 06:30 PT open; the rest expires at 13:00 PT.
Keysight, Elastic, Gap and Webull report after Thursday's close; their reaction session is Friday.
Thanksgiving week: US markets are closed Thursday 26 Nov and close early Friday 27 Nov.
